text.tspan:
Self-reported life satisfaction vs. GDP per capita
2011 to 2024

Self-reported life satisfaction is measured on a
scale
ranging from 0-10, where 10 is the highest possible life
satisfaction. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

Life satisfaction
(0–10; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: Wellbeing Research Centre (2026); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)

Note: GDP per capita is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices. Where a country or region lacks data for the years shown, the closest
available value within 5 years is shown instead.
